description: This source file implements CPU time-in-state tracking and related metrics for Android, utilizing eBPF maps and tracepoints. It includes functions for initializing global state, starting/stopping tracking, retrieving CPU frequency times, and managing per-UID and per-task data.

methods.name: readNumbersFromFile
methods.description: Reads space or newline-separated unsigned integers from a file at the given path, returning a vector of uint32_t or empty on failure.

methods.name: isPolicyFile
methods.description: Checks if a directory entry name starts with 'policy'.

methods.name: comparePolicyFiles
methods.description: Comparator for sorting policy files based on their numeric suffix.

methods.name: initGlobals
methods.description: Initializes global variables related to CPU policies, frequencies, and eBPF maps. Loads policy data, CPU mappings, and opens eBPF maps.

methods.name: retrieveProgramFd
methods.description: Constructs the path for a tracepoint program and retrieves its file descriptor.

methods.name: attachTracepointProgram
methods.description: Attaches a tracepoint program for a given event type and name.

methods.name: getPolicyFreqIdx
methods.description: Returns the index of the current frequency for a given policy.

methods.name: isTrackingUidTimesSupported
methods.description: Checks if UID time tracking is supported on the device by verifying availability of tracepoint programs.

methods.name: startTrackingUidTimes
methods.description: Starts tracking UID CPU times by attaching tracepoints and initializing eBPF maps.

methods.name: getCpuFreqs
methods.description: Returns available CPU frequency policies.

methods.name: getTotalCpuFreqTimes
methods.description: Retrieves total time spent at each CPU frequency across all CPUs and policies.

methods.name: getUidCpuFreqTimes
methods.description: Retrieves time spent by a specific UID at each CPU frequency.

methods.name: getUidsCpuFreqTimes
methods.description: Retrieves times for all UIDs at each CPU frequency.

methods.name: getUidsUpdatedCpuFreqTimes
methods.description: Retrieves updated times for UIDs, optionally excluding those not updated since a given timestamp.

methods.name: verifyConcurrentTimes
methods.description: Verifies that the sum of active and policy times are consistent.

methods.name: getUidConcurrentTimes
methods.description: Retrieves concurrent execution times for a specific UID.

methods.name: getUidsConcurrentTimes
methods.description: Retrieves concurrent execution times for all UIDs.

methods.name: getUidsUpdatedConcurrentTimes
methods.description: Retrieves updated concurrent times for UIDs, optionally excluding those not updated since a timestamp.

methods.name: clearUidTimes
methods.description: Clears all time-in-state data for a specific UID.

methods.name: startTrackingProcessCpuTimes
methods.description: Begins tracking CPU times for a specific process ID.

methods.name: startAggregatingTaskCpuTimes
methods.description: Marks a task for CPU time aggregation with a specified key.
